author: Xufen Tu
title: 当航空展成为公共空间里的技术体验
observation: During a public airshow by the ocean, aircraft appeared intermittently rather than all at once; each arrival drew people's attention upward and temporarily turned an ordinary hot beach scene into a shared public technology experience.
current_judgment: When powerful aviation technology enters public space through performance, speed, and sound, it should be understood not only as a technical display but also as something that shapes public emotion, shared attention, imagination, trust, and responsibility.
boundary: This record preserves a public observation and current judgment from a specific scene; it should not be treated as a complete conclusion or a full representation of the author.
